slug: 2025-07-10 Guinea-Bissau Council of Ministers approves three digital decrees (interoperability, data governance, cybersecurity)
note: Council of Ministers approved a draft decree (Projeto de Decreto) on the National Cybersecurity Strategy; a draft is not a stated adoption, so no fact.

facts.fact: ANG reports the Council of Ministers approved the National Cybersecurity Strategy of Guinea-Bissau at its ordinary meeting; no strategy period is stated, and the date is the meeting date inferred by the ingest.
facts.system: Estratégia Nacional de Cibersegurança da Guiné-Bissau

note: Feasibility study with draft strategy, crisis framework and terms of reference for a national CSIRT and CII protection; preparation only, nothing stated adopted, created or designated.

slug: 2025-01-22 Guinea-Bissau presents cybersecurity study, plans National Cybersecurity and Data Protection Agency
note: Minister announces a commitment to create a National Cybersecurity and Data Protection Agency after a study presentation; not yet created, no strategy adopted, so no fact.
A tender to identify a preliminary list of CII operators; nothing designated yet.
The National Cybersecurity Strategy 2025-2030 is only described as proposing a CSIRT and SOC; no adoption or body created is stated.
States no national cyber body, strategy or response for this country.
